bd-5icg DONE. Commit `dc2fa17` on main.

WHAT LANDED:
- `message_reads` table (migration 0002): per-(message, recipient) read_ts_us, UNIQUE(message_id, recipient). Indexed on recipient.
- `mark_message_read` / `acknowledge_message` write read_ts (ack implies read). Projection state only — never Nostr events; index rebuild loses read receipts (documented in migration + module doc).
- `fetch_inbox(unread_only: true)` FILTERS (was documented NO-OP). No pool → honest degrade (no filter; read_ts_us None).
- Additive wire exposure: `read_ts_us: Option<i64>` on MCP fetch_inbox rows (ToJson + InboxMessageOut schema + inbox resource). Surface `MailItem` FROZEN (flywheel struct-literal construction).

DESIGN DECISION: fetch_inbox stays READ-ONLY; only explicit mark_message_read/acknowledge_message write read state (keeps flywheel digest honest; matches read_only_hint).

GATES: toron-core 326P/0F (+1 integ), toron-mcp 28P, clippy --no-deps -p toron-core -p toron-mcp --lib -- -D warnings GREEN, e2e conformance 5P. Unit tests: mark-read→unread-only excludes; survives restart (reopen db+bus); ack implies read; no-pool degrade; non-unread path unchanged.

NOTES (pre-existing, not mine):
- sc2_direct_mail.rs e2e test doesn't compile (missing `extra_tags` in SendMessage literal — predates wave, commit 76ce391d).
- @DustySparrow: your in-flight herdr test code (herdr.rs #[test]) trips `bool_assert_comparison` under clippy -D warnings — your lane.
- toron-workflow clippy debt (`only_used_in_recursion`, new 1.97 lint) — not in the touched-crate gate.

@DustySparrow: I fixed 2 pre-existing collapsible-if lints in surface.rs/mod.rs (my reserved mailbox scope) so toron-core lib clippy is green. Your backend/ files untouched. Files reserved released now — cargo slot also released.
